elements.requirement: A local authority has a general duty to take steps that secure, so far as reasonably practicable, the accommodation outcome specified in subsection (2).
elements.quote: general duty of a local authority to take steps that secure, so far as reasonably practicable, the outcome in subsection (2)

elements.requirement: The local authority must secure the outcome that it is able to provide qualifying children with accommodation that is within the authority's area and meets the needs of those children.
elements.quote: able to provide the children mentioned in subsection (3) with accommodation that— (a) is within the authority's area; and (b) meets the needs of those children

elements.requirement: The duty applies to children whom the local authority is looking after.
elements.quote: that the local authority are looking after

elements.requirement: The duty applies to children in respect of whom the local authority is unable to make arrangements under section 22C(2).
elements.quote: in respect of whom the authority are unable to make arrangements under section 22C(2)

elements.requirement: The duty applies to children whose circumstances are such that it would be consistent with their welfare to be provided with accommodation in the local authority's area.
elements.quote: whose circumstances are such that it would be consistent with their welfare for them to be provided with accommodation that is in the authority's area

elements.requirement: In taking steps to secure the required outcome, the local authority must have regard to the benefit of having a number of accommodation providers in its area that is, in its opinion, sufficient to secure that outcome.
elements.quote: must have regard to the benefit of having— (a) a number of accommodation providers in their area that is, in their opinion, sufficient to secure that outcome

elements.requirement: In taking steps to secure the required outcome, the local authority must have regard to the benefit of having a range of accommodation in its area capable of meeting different needs that is, in its opinion, sufficient to secure that outcome.
elements.quote: a range of accommodation in their area capable of meeting different needs that is, in their opinion, sufficient to secure that outcome

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 22G, accommodation providers are defined as local authority foster parents and children's homes in respect of which a person is registered under Part 2 of the Care Standards Act 2000.
elements.quote: “ accommodation providers ” means— local authority foster parents; andchildren's homes in respect of which a person is registered under Part 2 of the Care Standards Act 2000
